name: Old English
blurb: Germanic tribes settle Britain. A language of kennings and case endings, Beowulf and Alfred the Great. Vikings add Norse in the 800s.

name: Middle English
blurb: After the Norman Conquest, French rules court and law while English survives in the fields. When English returns, it is transformed — Chaucer's English.

name: Early Modern English
blurb: Printing, the Renaissance and Shakespeare. Thousands of Latin and Greek words pour in; the Great Vowel Shift changes how everything sounds.

name: Modern English
blurb: Dictionaries fix spelling, the Empire and science spread English around the world and borrow from every continent.

name: Global English
blurb: Radio, film and the internet. English becomes the world's lingua franca and coins words faster than ever: radar, emoji, selfie.
